subject: Automation for www.upwork.com
body:
Hi there! This is MECOS Automation — we specialize in building AI agents that eliminate manual work. I noticed www.upwork.com might benefit from automation around manual labor / operational overhead.

Our bots typically achieve 60%+ time reduction on processes like yours. For example, we recently cut a client's data entry from 4 hours/day to just 15 minutes.

We'd build a custom automation agent for manual labor / operational overhead that runs on your schedule — no daily management needed. Usually ready in 1-2 weeks.

Would you be interested in a free 15-minute audit to see what's possible? Or just reply 'DEMO' and I'll send a quick Loom showing how it works.

P.S. Know someone who'd benefit? Share this link: https://mecos-automation.com/ref/4c9d4e70

lead_brief.suggested_pitch: Automated solution for www.upwork.com targeting Manual Labor / Operational Overhead. Build: 2-3 days. Price: fixed scope. No long-term contract required.
